extDesc.message: Summarizes pages, answers questions about them, saves notes and fills in forms after you confirm.

menuAskSel.message: Ask the assistant about the selected text

onlineWarn.message: The page content is sent to an online service.

noHost.message: The assistant component is not responding. Restart the browser; if the problem persists, reinstall the Vela package.

restricted.message: This page can't be read. Internal browser pages and PDFs are not accessible to the assistant.

emptyHint.message: Pick an action or ask a question. The assistant reads the page only when you ask.

formNone.message: There are no forms to fill in on this page.

formFound.message: Fields found: $N$. Type the details to use: the assistant suggests values and you check them before they are entered.

formPlaceholder.message: E.g. Jane Smith, jane.smith@example.com, 1 Main St, London

formNoValues.message: The assistant found no suitable values. Add more details and try again.

formPreview.message: Check the values. Only the selected fields are filled in; the form is not submitted.

formDone.message: Fields filled in: $N$. Check the page and submit the form yourself.

formSkipped.message: Passwords and payment details are never filled in.
